brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested four Palestinian citizens during separate overnight raids on the West Bank villages of Tarqumiya and Kharas, the Ma'an news agency reported. Troops entered both communities in coordinated operations that targeted multiple locations across each village, detaining the four men as part of the sweeps.

The detentions mark the latest in a pattern of arrest operations carried out by Israeli forces across Palestinian population centers. No information was immediately available regarding the identities of those arrested or the specific allegations authorities cited for taking them into custody.
title: Israeli forces arrest four Palestinians during raids in Tarqumiya and Kharas.
